title: Hearing on jobs and pay for New Yorkers with disabilities
summary: The Council's Disabilities Committee will hold an oversight hearing on economic opportunity and employment for New Yorkers with disabilities, hearing from the Mayor's Office for People with Disabilities, the Department of Small Business Services and advocates. The hearing examines City programs like NYC:ATWORK, Workforce1 and the 55-a Program, and notes only 41% of disabled working-age New Yorkers are employed versus 81% of non-disabled residents. It also reviews the Adams administration's goal of placing 2,500 disabled New Yorkers in jobs by July 2026, of which about 1,350 had been placed as of June 2025.
